title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: An Eastern Bluebird (Sialia sialis) perched on a photovoltaic (PV) solar panel at an ecovoltaic site in southern Michigan, USA. Ecovoltaic PV designs combine photovoltaic electricity generation with restoration of ecosystem function, including habitat enhancement for birds and other wildlife. Full details are available in the article by Walston et al., https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70208. Photo: © Leroy Walston.
